title: Individual humanitarian index datasets — individual_indices
text: object data frame 195 rows 19 variables: country Country name master geography. iso3 Three-letter ISO 3166-1 country code. region United Nations M49 region. subregion United Nations M49 subregion. index_id Stable short identifier index. index_name Human-readable name index. source_country Country label publisher's source; missing country present source. score Publisher score original scale. score_label Publisher display label meaningful, including censored values, score ranges, percentages, classifications. reference_year Year period represented observation. edition Publisher's edition release label. score_direction Whether higher lower publisher score denotes greater vulnerability: higher_worse lower_worse. rankable Whether index eligible ranking. eligible_for_counts Whether available rank contributes country-level summary counts proportions. n_scored Number countries exact numeric score index. rank Rank among scored countries, 1 denoting vulnerable; ties receive minimum rank. decile Vulnerability decile derived rank, 1 (vulnerable) 10 (least vulnerable). top_10 Whether country vulnerability rank 10 better. top_20 Whether country vulnerability rank 20 better.

title: Individual humanitarian index datasets — individual_indices
text: Publisher scores retain original scales. Rankings calculated separately within index's exact numeric coverage; missing censored scores ranked. Deciles min(10, floor(10 * (rank - 1) / n_scored) + 1). Ties use minimum rank, 10 20 countries can top_10 top_20 set TRUE. included datasets : inform_risk: INFORM Risk, 2026 v0.7.2. Measures humanitarian crisis disaster risk; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. inform_severity: INFORM Severity, June 2026. Measures current crisis severity; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. Coverage publisher's country sheet. underfunded_crisis: Underfunded Crisis Index, 2025. Reports cumulative share requirements funded 2021–2025; lower percentages indicate greater vulnerability. Regional plans excluded. oecd_fragility: OECD Multidimensional Fragility, States Fragility 2025. Measures exposure risk insufficient resilience; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. public artifact covers 61 high- extreme-fragility contexts. worldrisk: WorldRiskIndex, 2025. Measures disaster risk exposure societal vulnerability; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. nd_gain: ND-GAIN Country Index, 2026 release using 2024 scores. Measures climate vulnerability adaptation readiness; lower overall scores indicate greater vulnerability. hdi: Human Development Index, Human Development Report 2025 using 2023 scores. Measures health, education, living standards; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. mpi: Global Multidimensional Poverty Index, 2025. Measures overlapping household deprivations; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. Reference years vary country survey. ghi: Global Hunger Index, 2025. Measures hunger undernourishment child-health indicators; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. exact values ranked; censored values ranges remain labels. ghs: Global Health Security Index, 2021. Measures epidemic pandemic preparedness; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. wps: Women, Peace Security Index, 2025/26. Measures women's inclusion, justice, security; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. un_mvi: United Nations Multidimensional Vulnerability Index, High-Level Panel results using 2023 data. Measures structural vulnerability lack resilience; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. debt_distress: IMF debt-distress classification, 31 March 2026. published class paired derived ordinal code 1 (low) 4 (debt distress); intentionally ranked placed deciles. searo: Sexual Exploitation Abuse Risk Overview, 2026 v1.2 using December 2025 data. Measures contextual safeguarding risk; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. disaster_displacement: IDMC Disaster Displacement Risk Model, GDRM 2.0. Intended report current-climate annual average displacement, higher values indicating greater vulnerability. Values missing snapshot stable country table available. internal_displacement: IDMC Internal Displacement Index, 2022 values published 2023. Measures policy, capacity, drivers, impacts; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. Numeric coverage 44 countries.
